purpose: Teach: 椎/蕾/唾/皺/両端/左折/８つ/スギ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが椎の木を裏山に植えられた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, my father planted a shiitake tree on the back mountain.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic opening. Soft focus on distant memory. Measured pace, each image given space to settle. Voice carries quiet reverence for the father he's remembering.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、毎年桜の蕾を観に行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and didn't your grandfather go every year to see the cherry blossoms open, dear?
lines.style: Warm, conversational agreement. Light emphasis on 「毎年」 — the routine he kept. Affectionate lift at 「dear?」, like she's checking he remembers it too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは唾棄すべき行為を許さなかった
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, my father never tolerated a contemptible act.
lines.style: Steady, dignified recollection. The words carry moral weight without harshness. Slight pause before the weight — this is something that mattered. Clear-eyed, not softened.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、私の和服の皺を伸ばして下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And didn't your grandfather help me press the wrinkles from my kimono, dear?
lines.style: Tender, specific memory surfacing. Slight softening on the intimate detail of the kimono care. The question rises gently at the end — a small moment of gentleness she's confirming together.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが古い家の両端の柱を補強された
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, my father reinforced both pillars of the old house.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate recollection. Respect for the practical strength — the work that held things up. Even pacing, steady as the reinforced pillars themselves. No sentiment, just fact and care.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、市役所で左折される道を教えて下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And didn't your grandfather show me the way to turn left at the city office, dear?
lines.style: Light, intimate memory. A small kindness rendered in a practical moment. Gently teasing affection — she's weaving small, everyday acts of his attention into the conversation. Rises at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが正月に子供達に８つの教えを伝えられた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, my father taught the children eight principles every New Year.
lines.style: Formal, weighted recollection. Respect for the tradition and the deliberation required to pass it on. Slight formality in the delivery — this is about legacy, not casualness. Clear and grounded.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、スギ林の手入れをされてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And didn't you tend the cedar grove so carefully in those days, dear?
lines.style: Warm close, voice settling into affection. Gentle correction—she's turning the mirror back, reminding him of his own tender care. Soft fadeout on 「dear,」 like the conversation is finding its rest.
